title: Let helplessness tell the truth
summary: Pain can wake dependence when pleasure has kept the heart asleep. Let the limit tell the truth, then answer it with praise of the One whose light fills everything.
takeaway: Let pain uncover dependence, then turn the exposed heart toward praise.
lifeApplication: When hurt exposes how little you control, do not rush to rename it failure. Admit the limit, then speak one line of praise from inside the exposed place.

source.shortMeaning: Pain can wake dependence when pleasure has kept the heart asleep.
source.lifeApplication: When pain exposes your limit, tell the truth before reaching for relief.
